patterns.label: Read receipts, no reply (24–72h)
patterns.example: Two messages were read (check marks) with no reply for 48 hours.

patterns.label: Stopped replying for a week+
patterns.example: No response to three messages over two weeks.

patterns.label: Spoke over me mid-sentence
patterns.example: While I was speaking, they began speaking and my sentence stopped mid-word.

patterns.label: One person monopolized the meeting
patterns.example: One person spoke for most of the meeting time.

patterns.label: Cross-talk (multiple people at once)
patterns.example: Three people spoke at once; I couldn’t get a word in.

patterns.label: Plan changed without asking
patterns.example: They changed the plan and said, “You’ll do it this way.”

patterns.label: Decision made without my input
patterns.example: The decision was announced after I asked to contribute.

patterns.label: Criteria changed after I delivered
patterns.example: After I finished, new requirements were added.

patterns.label: Voice got louder or yelling
patterns.example: Their voice volume increased during our talk.

patterns.label: Door slam / loud exit
patterns.example: The door closed loudly during the conversation.

patterns.label: Mocking / sarcastic tone
patterns.example: They imitated my voice after my question.

patterns.label: Arrived 15–30 minutes late
patterns.example: We agreed on 2:00; they arrived at 2:20 without a message.

patterns.label: Canceled at short notice
patterns.example: They canceled 30 minutes before our meeting.

patterns.label: Looked at phone / kept typing
patterns.example: They looked at their phone while I was talking.

patterns.label: No eye contact / distracted
patterns.example: They kept typing without looking up.

patterns.label: Touched / hugged without asking
patterns.example: They put a hand on my shoulder without asking.

patterns.label: Shared or showed private info
patterns.example: They screen-shared a direct message I sent.

patterns.label: Entered my space without knocking
patterns.example: They entered my room without knocking.

patterns.label: Stood too close in public
patterns.example: They stood close enough that our shoulders touched.

patterns.label: Used my things without asking
patterns.example: They used my laptop account without asking.

patterns.label: Damaged my property
patterns.example: They dropped my tablet; the screen cracked.

patterns.label: No credit / credit taken
patterns.example: My contribution was used without my name.

patterns.label: Negative remark in public
patterns.example: They said 'This is a waste of time' while I spoke.

patterns.label: “Where are you really from?” etc.
patterns.example: They asked 'Where are you really from?' in the meeting.

patterns.label: Unfavorable comparison
patterns.example: “Unlike Alex, you don’t follow through.”

patterns.label: Key info omitted
patterns.example: I learned a requirement after submission closed.

patterns.label: Late-night urgent pings / early deadline
patterns.example: Three pings after 10pm for a 7am turnaround.
needs: Do things at my own pace and in my own way

patterns.label: Loud / repeated noise
patterns.example: Alarms sounded repeatedly for 20 minutes.

patterns.label: Shared space left messy
patterns.example: Shared sink full after agreed chore time.

patterns.label: Someone cut in line
patterns.example: They stepped ahead of me at checkout.

patterns.label: Unexpected fee / higher price
patterns.example: Final bill had fees not in the quote.

patterns.label: Texting / unsafe driving
patterns.example: They looked at their phone on the highway.
